_readme: GT (2026-10-02, owner ruling D6): the STARTER ALLOWLIST for the per-bar runtime pane.
While PINE_RUNTIME_STAGE is admins, cohort or all, the runtime lane draws ONLY a script whose
Pine source sha256 (UTF-8, as written) starts with one of the sha256 values below or one
in the PINE_RUNTIME_ALLOWLIST variable on web (the server reads the union, per request).
Every other script declines by name (runtime:not-yet-graded) with the host lane's sentence.
ADD A SCRIPT ONLY WHEN A TRADINGVIEW CAPTURE GRADES IT MATCH: one object per script, naming
the capture. Read by api/services/runtime_definitions.py::allow_list. An empty list serves
nothing. Edit this file as text; never round-trip it through a serialiser.
WS-I (2026-10-31, owner ruling R1): a script below is SERVED only when it passes
api/services/rollout_gate.py::pine_runtime_admission, in this order:
1. PER-CAPABILITY CONFORMANCE (the primary gate). `capabilities` names every census
capability the script uses (the ids of tools/pine_coverage/coverage_map.py::FEATURES;
tests/test_pine_runtime_switch_on.py holds the list to the census detector, so it can
never under-declare), and EVERY one of them must be `conformant` in the `capabilities`
registry at the bottom of this file, with evidence named.
2. AT LEAST ONE MATCH CAPTURE. `captures` names a TradingView capture of THIS script
(tests/fixtures/vendor/harness/<id>.json, its source hashing to `sha256`) graded MATCH
with the runtime pane ON.
A committed script that fails either is WITHHELD (served as not graded, never deleted) and
tests/test_pine_runtime_switch_on.py goes red BY NAME, so an ungraded line cannot be
committed by accident. A capability marked `divergent` withholds every script that uses it:
`conditional-ta` (R4) is that row until WS-C lands per-call-site history.
WS-I PART 2 (2026-11-13): ADMISSION BY CAPABILITY. With PINE_RUNTIME_CAPABILITY_ADMISSION=on the
browser pane ALSO serves a script whose EVERY capability (api/services/pine_capabilities.py::
capabilities_of: one detector, over-declaring, closed world, `core` declared by every script) is
ADMITTED below: `admitted: true`, `status: conformant`, and evidence naming at least 2 captures of
2 DISTINCT scripts (a probe and its variants are one script), at least one a COMMUNITY script, each
{capture, script, community, verdict: MATCH, runtimePane: on} and drawn by the RUN; an `obj:*`
family also needs objectsV2: MATCH, objectsLane: runtime and objectsPaired > 0 (records paired, never
pairedNothing) on each, and NO entry whose x grade (objectsX, U13) is DIVERGE (U1, 2026-11-15). A capability
absent from this registry withholds every script that uses it. api/services/rollout_gate.py::
pine_capability_admission reads it; tests/test_pine_capability_admission.py holds every evidence id
to a real capture graded MATCH in docs/pine/vendor-harness/runtime-on/verdicts.json (A8). The
server lanes (alerts, scans) never admit by capability: they stay per-script (`scripts` above).
L7 (2026-11-14, owner ruling option (a)): THE SUBSTITUTED PATH. A script the member door serves with
UCT data in place of a vendor-only fact (syminfo.industry, a seed with no public mirror) can never
grade MATCH; its harness grade is MATCH_SUBSTITUTED. Such a record is admitted ONLY when it says
`admission: "substituted"` and `substituted: [<Pine name>...]`, and names a capture graded
MATCH_SUBSTITUTED with the runtime pane on whose own `substituted` names are exactly the record's
(rollout_gate.pine_runtime_admission). A MATCH_SUBSTITUTED capture never admits a record without
`admission`. The served row carries the names, and /api/user-definitions/runtime-kill serves them as
`substituted` {sha256: [names]} for the member door to disclose. No such record exists yet.
RS RATING L8 (2026-11-15): RUN-HALF OBJECT EVIDENCE, FROM THESE SAME RECORDS. A host document whose
run half draws what the host draws none of (run-half:no-comparable-objects) is drawn only on recorded
evidence: a capture entry may carry `objectsV2: "MATCH"` (or the grade it got), the objects-v2 grade
of the RUN's drawings in docs/pine/vendor-harness/runtime-on/verdicts.json (tests/
test_pine_run_half_evidence.py holds every such claim to that file). For each SERVED record those
entries are served by /api/user-definitions/runtime-kill as `run_half_evidence` (absent when none)
and the browser admits the run half on at least 2 distinct captures each MATCH, objectsV2 MATCH, pane
on (engine/runHalfRailSeam.js). No record carries one yet.
G6 (2026-11-15, coordinator ruling): `realtime-state` admits ONLY with scope `closed-bar-history`. A script
admitted by capability that uses it is drawn bar by bar only while the chart's newest bar is known to be
closed; on a forming or untold bar it is refused by name (runtimeKill.js::runtimeFormingRefusalOf).
obj:box IS DELIBERATELY ABSENT (coordinator ruling 2026-11-15). Its y evidence passes the rule (6 / 4 / 3),
but the runtime lane's object defaults are not version-aware: a v4 box.new with no border_color draws
#2962ff (v5+ color.blue) where TradingView draws #2196f3 (v4 color.blue). Evidence: capture
inside-bar-boxes-rddt-1d-2026-11-14, runtime-drawn, objects v2 DIVERGE on box border_color. The family
waits for runtime object defaults made version-aware (engine 58's palette table). Absent = withheld:
tests/test_pine_capability_admission.py rails that it stays out until that fix lands.
U15 LIBRARIES (coordinator ruling 2026-11-15): ONE ROW PER LIBRARY VERSION, named `library:Author/Library/N`
(each version is different code; pine_capabilities.capabilities_of names one per import line). A row pins
the version by `sha256` (the sha256 of the library source its evidence graded) and admits on the family
rule: >= 2 distinct IMPORTING scripts graded MATCH with the runtime pane on, >= 1 of them community, each
evidence entry naming `library: {path, sha256}` equal to the row's. An entry graded against other code under
the version, or against a fixture library (`libraryFixture: true`), never counts. A TradingView-authored
library is fine: the importing scripts are what must be community. The generic `import` capability is never
a row of its own: it is met only when EVERY library version the script imports is admitted
(runtime_definitions.capability_admitted). No library row is admitted yet.
U3b (2026-11-15): since U13 (#1335) objects v2 grades x, and the U1 evidence taken before the x table
grades INCONCLUSIVE; every obj:* row is re-derived from x-graded re-captures (objectsX = the capture's own
x verdict). obj:linefill is WITHDRAWN: no x-graded linefill capture yet (its three old captures grade
INCONCLUSIVE). calc-bars is HELD (not a row): its 2 / 2 evidence passes the count, but only
wyckoff-accumulation-distribution-spy-1d-2026-10-02 runs on more bars than its calc_bars_count; Sweep
Reversal Map declares calc_bars_count = 10000 on charts of 666 and 8507 bars, so ignoring the argument
draws the same picture and the capture witnesses nothing about it.
S28 (2026-11-15): every obj:* row is re-derived with the S28 x re-captures. A script with ANY capture whose x
DIVERGES, or on the committed kill list (pine_runtime_killlist.json), is evidence for no object family:
trend-targets-algoalpha (x DIVERGES on RDDT, killed) and parabolic-sar (a label one decimal short on SPY, killed).
obj:linefill stays withdrawn (FVG Finder alone once AlgoAlpha is vetoed: one script).
